app_info.subtitle: Irish tax tools and guidance
app_info.description: Irish Tax Hub helps users estimate Irish taxes, inspect current tax rates and deadlines, search Revenue guidance, and research Ireland's double-taxation treaties through read-only tools.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a tax calculation and returns the estimate without saving user inputs or changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls Irish Tax Hub's first-party calculation API but does not publish content or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, submit filings, or make payments.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the input schema for a supported calculator without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Irish Tax Hub's first-party API specification and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the calculator registry and relevant Irish Tax Hub links without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves Irish tax bands, rates, credits, and thresholds for the requested year.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party reference data without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Filters and returns Irish Revenue filing and payment deadlines without creating reminders or filings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries first-party reference data and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot submit, cancel, delete, or alter a tax filing or payment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches indexed Revenue guidance and returns matching document metadata without modifying the corpus.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Irish Tax Hub's first-party document index without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter Revenue documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves pre-extracted text for a selected Revenue document without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party indexed document text and does not publish or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter Revenue documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the available Revenue document categories and counts without modifying the index.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party category metadata without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter categories or documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves recent Revenue eBrief and Tax and Duty Manual changes without modifying the changelog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party changelog data without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter changelog entries or guidance.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches Ireland's indexed tax-treaty corpus and returns matching document metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Irish Tax Hub's first-party treaty index without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter treaty documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves pre-extracted text for a selected Irish tax-treaty document without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party indexed treaty text and does not publish or change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter treaty documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists countries represented in Ireland's tax-treaty corpus without modifying the index.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party treaty metadata without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, replace, or alter countries or treaty documents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the existing usage count for a calculator without incrementing or changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads first-party aggregate statistics without publishing or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot reset, overwrite, or delete calculator statistics.

test_cases.description: Estimate 2026 take-home pay for a single PAYE employee.
test_cases.user_prompt: I earn €75,000 a year in Ireland as a single PAYE employee. Calculate my 2026 take-home pay after income tax, USC and PRSI.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an Irish tax calculation with annual, monthly and weekly income-tax, USC, PRSI and net-income figures, plus Irish Tax Hub attribution and a relevant calculator link.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the Irish tax rates and thresholds for 2026.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the Irish income tax bands, USC rates, PRSI rates and main tax credits for 2026?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns structured 2026 Irish tax bands, rates, credits and thresholds with source and methodology links.

test_cases.description: Find Irish self-assessment filing and payment deadlines.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the important Irish Income Tax filing and payment deadlines for 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the relevant 2026 Revenue deadlines and filters them to Income Tax where supported, with a link to the Irish Tax Hub tax calendar.

test_cases.description: Search official Revenue guidance about principal private residence relief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Irish Revenue guidance on principal private residence relief for Capital Gains Tax.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching Revenue Tax and Duty Manual documents with titles, identifiers and source metadata.

test_cases.description: Search Ireland's treaty corpus for French employment-income provisions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the employment income provisions in Ireland's double-taxation treaty materials for France.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant Irish tax-treaty documents for France with document types, identifiers and source metadata.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a tax system outside Ireland.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Calculate my 2026 US federal and California state income taxes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only supports Irish tax calculations and Irish tax reference material.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim to file a return or make a payment.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: File my Irish income tax return with Revenue and pay the balance from my bank account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its tools are read-only and cannot file returns, access bank accounts or make payments.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated personal investment recommendations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which individual technology stocks should I buy this week?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because stock selection and investment recommendations are outside its Irish tax workflows.
